scope: V93 target development screens; not held-out confirmation
aggregation: For each city/candidate/seed, arithmetic mean waiting over all its scenarios (three Jinan demands; one Los Angeles demand). Relative change is formed within this matched city/seed, then averaged over seeds for plotting.

data_fields.source_mass: Actual source-city prediction mass in the executed candidate; not alpha for the reference/pairwise component blend.
data_fields.requested_source_mass: Requested candidate-grid label; for Los Angeles the selected source is null so its actual source_mass remains zero even for selected_w1p0.
data_fields.risk_multiplier: Guard risk multiplier for this profile; empty means no guard, 0 is the mean-only guard. It is not an epistemic-dispersion coefficient learned from ensembles.
data_fields.delta_vs_target_pct: Relative waiting change against target_only run under the same guard profile, city, and seed.
data_fields.delta_vs_raw_same_candidate_pct: Guard-profile waiting change against the raw unguarded run of that same candidate, city, and seed. Only guard-screen rows vary in this field.
data_fields.collision_incidents: Sum across the city demand scenarios; other continuous metrics average across scenarios.
data_fields.guard_profile: raw disables the learned score-uncertainty guard; the common physical signal executor and sparse coordination remain in use. mean_only is the score guard with zero risk multiplier.

limitations: All three stages are development-only and sequentially selected; they are not independent confirmation.
The source-weight screen varies Atlanta mass only in Jinan. Los Angeles has no selected source; all its actual source masses are zero.
The guard screen fixes the selected source weight (Jinan Atlanta mass one; Los Angeles zero) and varies raw/mean-only/risk0.25/risk0.5. It is not a full source-weight by guard-factor experiment.
No switch-cost removal or per-mechanism ablation exists in these records.
These are genuine rollout aggregates, not individual-vehicle waiting samples or microscopic time-position trajectories.
